thread:
incident-bot: [CRITICAL] Node nv-gpu-17 in goldcrest-dedicated-pool triggered ECC parity spike and subsequent kernel panic. Allocations failing for Goldcrest tenants. Alert INC-20260315-01. Paging on-call.

maria_ops: taking the page, oncall here. will coordinate triage.

jay_oncall: i'm on it — initial check shows repeated AER/ECC entries. cordoning node and starting graceful drain. tagging @eng_runtime and @kate_platform for capacity/fallback.

jay_oncall: running drain command now:

```
/dedpool drain --node nv-gpu-17 --reason "ECC parity spike, kernel panic" --force --timeout 300
kubectl cordon node-nv17
kubectl drain node-nv17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```

jay_oncall: sample dmesg at panic time:

```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 79, 0a, 00000000, 00000000, 00000000
[ 1234.567892] NVRM: GPU 0000:3b:00:00: 4: ECC error from memory subsystem
[ 1234.567895] Kernel panic - not syncing: fatal exception
```

eng_runtime: thanks. recommend immediate live-fallback for Goldcrest's high-priority routes: enable model-variant fallback (goldcrest->redwood-small) and route new requests to reserve-3 pool while we isolate. this will keep latency SLOs for critical flows.

kate_platform: I can spin up reserve-3 capacity now. provisioning 4 GPUs (2x A100) from spare-standby. ETA 3m. will attach to goldcrest routing and update RBAC.

sre_bot: Runbook match: "DedPool ECC spike". Suggested steps posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedpool-ecc. Auto-checklist: cordon -> drain -> migrate-tenants -> monitor 10m -> RMA.

customer_success: prepping a status note for Goldcrest account: "We're isolating a hardware node in your dedicated pool. We're routing traffic to a reserve pool to avoid interruption. No data loss expected. Next update in 15 minutes." Will post after confirmation of successful tenant move.

ops_lead: creating RMA ticket and scheduling hardware swap. RMA-98765 created, priority P2 due to customer SLA. ETA onsite 24h.

maria_ops: cross-checking allocations now. I see 12 pods rescheduled from node-nv17 to reserve-3. No pod crashes in last 2 minutes. Running health checks on Goldcrest model endpoints.

jay_oncall: drain finished — node cordoned and evacuated :white_check_mark:. marking node out-of-service, removing from scheduler.

eng_runtime: confirming fallback enabled and traffic split updated to 100% reserve-3 for critical routes. Observability shows latency within SLO for goldcrest-primary routes.

customer_success: posting customer update now with link to incident thread and brief mitigation summary.

sre_bot: Post-mitigation checks initiated: token throughput, error-rate, model quality tests. All nominal after failover.

ops_lead: RMA scheduled, hardware vendor pickup ticket attached to RMA-98765. Please snapshot dmesg and nvml logs and attach to the ticket.

maria_ops: logs archived: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3959991234/nv17-logs.tar.gz and linked on the RMA ticket.

jay_oncall: temporary remediation done. Node will remain quarantined until replacement or deeper bench diagnosis. Recommend removing node from dedpool rotation permanently for now.

eng_runtime: plan to validate kernel and firmware on replacement board; provisioning replacement image next-run. Will follow up with a quant/regression eval against Goldcrest prompts to ensure no regressions.

ops_lead: assign postmortem to @maria_ops. target SEV3 writeup within 72h.

maria_ops: ack, I will own the postmortem and follow-ups. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

customer_success: Goldcrest notified. They asked for ETA on full pool restoration — will coordinate with ops on timeline.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-01 status: mitigated (node isolated, tenants failed over to reserve pool). Updates: next update expected +15m or on notable change."
